smell_validity.evidence: Every fattened seam demands capability its body never invokes: one-shot helpers typed to the sync trio while each calls one method; three context seams fused identically; cache and proxy shells requiring the unified surface for prepare alone; the public placeholder format carrying a debug hook. The forced WrapStdSqlCtx(db) retrofit shows even the standard database target failing the fat contract—unmistakable cost and healthy boundary.

maintenance_impact.evidence: The burden is lasting, not local: providers with partial repertoires stop fitting public seams and future implementors grow stubs; the cache's probe asserts a distinction its types now guarantee, leaving its NoContextSupport error unreachable; the hard-coded wrapper and stale constructor docs mislead readers. Repair restores genuine capability boundaries, but architecture-level '[ outcomes '[ evidence is thinner.

development_plausibility.evidence: The wave mirrors a real maintainer reflex to interface-zoo complaints: one union surface plus embedding-based compatibility aliases, narrating doc comments, byte-identical bodies, and a hurried wrapper retrofit at the single non-compiling call site. Deliberate asymmetries—an untouched query-row helper, unaffected builder plumbing, inconsistent comment fixes—remove task-shaped regularity, yielding production-level authenticity.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt pins every mismatch class verifiable in the diff, defines completion as consumed-capability matching rather than fixed names, and preserves byte-identical rendering, exact error identities, and export continuity—decisively blocking wrong direction and cheap partial fixes. Explicit exclusions (no re-imposed obligations to compile, no test re-pointing, no rendering restructure) make it a reliable contract.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Five purposes force different code-supported decisions: restoring per-capability helper parameters; splitting the identically-fused context trio; scoping the cache narrow enough that its runtime context probe stays meaningful; reconciling wrapper return, standard-contract width, and the proxy call; relocating the debug token behind a private probe. Same-operation clustering across files does not cover these.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt enumerates seam classes, but exact declarations require following cache constructors, wrapper returns, and call sites across files, and resolving embedded alias declarations. Plausible look-alikes need excluding: probe-based builder storage and the already-narrow query-row helper. Discovery stays direct—the enumeration limits chaining of indirect mechanisms—keeping this below the top bar.

repair_coordination.evidence: Two rules interlock at the proxy constructor: prepare-scoping the cache contracts and reconciling wrapper/standard-contract widths. Narrowing constructors alone leaves a compilable, suite-passing package that still carries the merged surface and the hard-coded wrapper. Field narrowing must also preserve reachability of the runtime context probe's NoContextSupport error.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Consumed capabilities differ everywhere—exec, query, three context methods, prepare pair, replace-only—so target shapes are separate per-site decisions, not one replacement. The best uniform rules examined (restore name-matched single-capability execution seams; prepare-scope the cache family per its retained doc text) each cover three to five of roughly fourteen sites, landing in the 20–40% band.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Shape-level wrong repairs slip past the suite, which the record says passed untouched through the entire wave: statically guaranteeing the cache's context capability silently strands the NoContextSupport path while ordinary standard-target calls succeed; keeping fat aliases or the wrapper indirection compiles and passes yet still rejects partial providers like the prompt's storage adapter.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
